name: The St. Regis Bali
positioning: The St. Regis Bali Resort: a beach resort in Nusa Dua with a lagoon pool winding through the property, villas with private pools and 24-hour butler service
best_for: Couples who want a villa with its own pool, steps from the beach
Families who want a Children's Club and a lagoon pool
Food lovers interested in Balinese, Pan-Asian and Champagne rituals

facts.text: The resort sits on the beach at Nusa Dua.
The one- and two-bedroom Lagoon Villas have direct access to the resort's lagoon.
The one-bedroom Strand Villas have direct access to the white-sand beach.
Each private villa has its own pool and a gazebo.
The resort offers 24-hour St. Regis Butler Service.
Kayuputi serves Pan-Asian beachfront dining facing the Indian Ocean.
Boneka is inspired by Indonesia's puppet theater and serves Asian and international flavors.
Breakfast at Boneka includes signature dishes such as Lobster Omelet and Wagyu Steak and Eggs.
Vista Bar is a beachfront swim-up bar.
Iridium Spa includes private suites with outdoor bathtubs, hydrotherapy pools, aromatherapy steam rooms, a facial studio and a beauty salon.
Yoga is held daily at Bale Pantai, a beachside pavilion overlooking the ocean.
The Children's Club offers activities including art, music, cooking, yoga and conservation programs.

highlights.text: A lagoon pool meanders through the property.
At The St. Regis Bar's evening ritual, a sommelier sabers Champagne with an Indonesian kris.
Guests can snorkel with a guide at the resort's cultivated reef.
Dulang serves Balinese food in a carved gazebo, with drinks such as brem and kopi luwak.
Rindik music plays in the lobby and a fire dance is performed at sunset by the Grand Staircase.

considerations.text: The complimentary airport transfer is only for guests in the St. Regis Pool Suite, Grand Astor Suite, Villa and Residence categories.
Coral Discovery is available year-round, subject to weather conditions.
WhataHotel notes the Nusa Dua location may require transportation for cultural exploration.
